sermon.title: Channeling Fear 01/27/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Opening a series on surviving tragedy, Pastor David G. Kincer looks at Job: a complete, mature man who lost wealth, children, health and harmony at home without sinning. His real fear was losing God’s presence, and he resolved to find Him and come forth as gold. God Himself is our exceeding great reward.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: What was Job really afraid of losing?

faqs.question: Convert vs. follower?
faqs.answer: A convert joins religion; a follower follows Christ.

faqs.question: Does he hold to six-day creation?
faqs.answer: Yes, as part of the doctrine of Christ.

faqs.question: What did Job say to his wife?
faqs.answer: You speak as a foolish woman speaks.

faqs.question: Can believers hear from God?
faqs.answer: Yes, he says most don’t believe it.

faqs.question: Does God do whatever He pleases?

scriptures.text_nkjv: “But He is unique, and who can make Him change? And whatever His soul desires, that He does.
